688:t_3:266.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I think you'll need our power in the battles ahead too, nya~.」

688:t_3:267.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The future our departed comrades entrusted to us... Please allow me to fight for it as well.」

688:t_3:273.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You mean the $$ＡＧ$$ costume, nya~?」

688:t_3:276.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Putting this on really calms me down.」

688:t_3:279.en:
$n
「That was Boost Up combined with Jeet Kune Do. For now, we'll call that even for keeping secrets from us.」

688:t_3:284.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This time, I'll bend my principles as well.」

688:t_3:285.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$カレン$$... I'll leave my share to you and $$スザク$$.」

688:t_3:287.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then I'll give you both shares at once!」

688:t_3:291.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Sorry, $$アレルヤ$$! It's my turn here!」

688:t_3:293.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm counting on you to handle our share, $$シルヴィア$$.」

688:t_3:295.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this, $$シンジ$$! We'll punch him once and settle this without any hard feelings!」

688:t_3:297.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ブレラ$$.」

688:t_3:305.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-Wait! I really can't take an Armor Magnum!」

688:t_3:307.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「J-Joking...!? This is $$キリコ$$ we're talking about!」

688:t_3:308.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If I meant to kill you, I'd have done it from the start.」

688:t_3:309.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You used tricks like the $$バインドスペル$$ on us. We'll take the liberty of doing this much.」

688:t_3:310.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, well... That shell you're so proud of is all dented. I'll repair it later.」

688:t_3:312.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have more than enough to say to you. But for now, let's move forward.」

688:t_3:313.en:
$$バナージ$$
「At least we share your desire to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:314.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But if you ever betray us...」

688:t_3:316.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I understand, $$正太郎$$! Please put down the V-Con!」

688:t_3:317.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let me be clear: this is only an emergency measure until we defeat the $$御使い$$s. Afterward, we will convene another discussion.」

688:t_3:318.en:
$$桂$$
「For now, keep the $$ＡＧ$$ mask on. It's easier to talk without extra preconceptions that way.」

688:t_3:319.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... That's fine. I... liked that role.」

688:t_3:320.en:
$$勝平$$
「You haven't reflected on anything at all!」

688:t_3:321.en:
$$万丈$$
「It means there's no point expecting that sort of thing from him.」

688:t_3:322.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's hope Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ inside him can keep him in check.」

688:t_3:323.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, we share a common enemy in the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:324.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To fight such a powerful foe, we may need to accept the bad along with the good.」

688:t_3:325.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uniting your purpose even with a former enemy... You truly have touched the universe's truth of living together.」

688:t_3:327.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ＡＧ$$. We have no intention of forgiving villains, even to stay alive.」

688:t_3:329.en:
$$トライア$$
「We don't have much time left either. First, we have to move forward.」

688:t_3:330.en:
$$エスター$$
「You say that, but where should we go?」

688:t_3:331.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$御使い$$s are probably tracking our movements through the $$烙印$$ they carved into us.」

688:t_3:332.en:
$$トライア$$
「Conversely, if we follow it back, we should reach them.」

688:t_3:333.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Can we really do that?」

688:t_3:334.en:
$$トライア$$
「It was only a theory until now, but it should be possible in this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

688:t_3:335.en:
$$トライア$$
「After all, this is a universe where recognition through will has power. Their intentions take on a clearer form.」

688:t_3:336.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「So it's a universe where recognition has power...」

688:t_3:337.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's why we could achieve $$真化融合$$ and Tengen Toppa.」

688:t_3:338.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then I'm sure we can meet her too...」

688:t_3:340.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is someone you know in this universe?」

688:t_3:341.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure... The last remaining one of the four $$御使い$$s...」

688:t_3:342.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman I sensed when we were transported to the $$カオス・コスモス$$ before...」

688:t_3:344.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think she's the $$御使い$$ who governs sorrow.」

688:t_3:345.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She's the only one among them who helps us...」
